Hello! I’m
Geraldine

A versatile marketer here to help you manage projects, deliver objectives, align functions and solve complex problems.

Experience
Services

Branding myself as an expert or guru of sorts is not really my thing. Here’s what you get if you work with me
👇

I am the curious cat 😻 who loves to connect the dots, enjoys preparing briefs and keeping others in the know, will stop at nothing to get answers and asks why? only all the time.

Adjectives that my colleagues have used to describe me over the years.

My Style

Once a project is under my wing, I’ll consider it personal and see it through from concept to delivery, execution, and optimization. I’ll provide creative input, efficiency, incisiveness, and a test-and-learn approach to ensure it moves smoothly and keeps growing.
I’ll conduct comprehensive research to verify the foundations are solid and build relationships with key stakeholders to ascertain their knowledge is leveraged and reflected in the project and that timelines are reasonable.
I’ll develop new ways of working when necessary, ensuring flows and processes are agreed upon by stakeholders and documented in an understandable format that allows new people to understand the full picture at a later stage.
